name: smwmusic-mario-is-missing-nes-new-york-usa
title: Mario is Missing! (NES) - New York USA
description:
Sampled version of the New York song heard in the "first stage" of Mario is Missing! for the NES.

Can be used in 8-bit towns, cities and other urban places.

Warning: Not recommended with SFX that use noise!
Not anymore, can be used anywhere no matter the sfx.

Old Description:

Huge thanks to brickblock369 and mish1 for helping with the port.

This is my first sampled port on the site, I hope you guys enjoy it! =D

(Samples from musicalman's Summer C3 2019 Thread found here - https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=viewthread&t=98488)

Edit: Pretty much redid the whole thing to be more accurate, now uses the correct percussion samples as well.
